notes.title: Warung Nasi Campur (Rice Bowl Restaurant) Available in 13 Languages!
notes.content:
Warung Nasi Campur (Rice Bowl Restaurant) avaliable in 13 different languanges! You can change it according to your preference language by selecting it in game setting's 🥳🥳

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43527284/75a0dcf7e3f1de354350b5255d7d176d465386bc.png[/img]

Of course, having various languages will make it easier for players other than Indonesian players who want to play our game.
